Test Steps: 1. Select PIM from the main menu. 2. Open Employee List if required.

Expected Result: Add Employee form is displayed and required inputs can be focused.

Test Case Title: Submit employee form with required values missing
Test Steps: 1. Leave required name inputs empty. 2. Select Save.
Expected Result: Required-field validation is shown and no employee is created.

Test Case Title: Create employee with unique synthetic data
Preconditions: Authorized user can access Add Employee
Test Steps: 1. Enter a unique first name and last name. 2. Enter a unique employee ID if editable. 3. Save.
Expected Result: Employee is created and the application navigates to the relevant details page.

Preconditions: A test employee was created in the current run
Test Steps: 1. Inspect the employee details page. 2. Compare displayed name fields with submitted values.
Expected Result: Displayed first and last names match the submitted values.

Preconditions: A known employee exists and Employee List is open
Test Steps: 1. Search with a known name or identifier. 2. Submit search.
Expected Result: The matching employee is returned and unrelated records do not appear as the sole match.

Test Steps: 1. Search using a unique nonexistent value. 2. Submit search.
Expected Result: No unrelated employee is presented as a match; empty-result feedback is understandable.

Test Steps: 1. Clear the criteria using the available UI. 2. Search again.
Expected Result: Criteria are cleared and the list reflects the default search behavior.

Test Case Title: Verify duplicate employee identifier is rejected
Preconditions: A known employee identifier already exists and the form allows entering IDs
Test Steps: 1. Attempt to save a different employee with the same identifier. 2. Observe validation and saved state.
Expected Result: Duplicate identity is rejected or handled according to approved product rules; no unintended duplicate record is created.

Test Steps: 1. Enter spaces only in each required name field. 2. Save.
Expected Result: Whitespace-only required values are rejected and no employee is created.

Preconditions: Add Employee form is open; any max length has been confirmed from UI or requirements
Test Steps: 1. Enter a name at the documented maximum. 2. Test one character beyond the maximum if allowed. 3. Observe validation.
Expected Result: Input is accepted or rejected according to the documented limit with clear feedback and no layout corruption.

Test Steps: 1. Enter temporary synthetic details. 2. Select Cancel. 3. Reopen the employee list and search for the temporary value.
Expected Result: User leaves the form without an unintended employee record being created.

Test Case Title: Open an existing employee detail record
Preconditions: At least one known test employee exists
Test Steps: 1. Search for the employee. 2. Open the matching result.
Expected Result: The detail page corresponds to the selected employee and its identifiers are consistent.

Preconditions: Test data contains more records than one page
Test Steps: 1. Open Employee List. 2. Navigate to the next page. 3. Return to the previous page.
Expected Result: Pagination controls navigate correctly without displaying duplicate or inconsistent rows.

Preconditions: Add Employee form is open and applicable format/length requirements are known
Test Steps: 1. Enter a valid identifier. 2. Test the observed lower/upper boundary and invalid format. 3. Save each applicable case.
Expected Result: Values follow the documented ID rules and invalid values receive clear feedback.
